scenarios.input: ProjectIntakeRepository validates projectId/title/idea, preserves accents and multiline text, and stores limits.
scenarios.original_snapshot: originalTitle/originalIdea/originalLimits and originalHash are write-once; suggestions update separate fields.
scenarios.type_depth: suggestion stores projectType, restrictions, depthMode and a visible reason; the repository permits correction.
scenarios.interpretation: FakeAiProvider suggestion is editable, explicitly accepted or rejected, and never becomes a decision automatically.
scenarios.progress: progressPercent and nextAction are derived from persisted snapshot state and rendered on the Home screen; no gate is advanced.
scenarios.rejection: reject clears interpretation, type, restrictions, depth and reason, then recomputes progress from the preserved original input.
scenarios.legacy: legacy projects without a nonblank draft do not receive an empty immutable snapshot; first valid input creates it.
scenarios.isolation: instrumented tests use two project IDs and assert progress/intake values do not cross projects

limitations: The default UI uses FakeAiProvider offline; selecting a real provider remains F04 configuration work.
The F03 backup envelope is not extended with the new intake table in this F05 change; Room persistence is covered.
Acceptance of F05 and registration of G05 require independent audit and explicit Product Authority action.
